purpose: Train every promising architecture-distinct or training-history-distinct scientist to a common Q60 milestone; this is capability growth, not a tournament.
milestone: Q20 plus Q40-1 equals 60 cumulative representations
launch_policy: Agreement means implement, launch, verify live workers and fresh artifacts in the same turn, then monitor; prepared or queued work must never be reported as running.

deferred.raster-invariant-jones-12: Low frozen-panel retention and no demonstrated compensating capability.
deferred.cyclic-band-bstar: Different schema; requires a fresh checkpoint and buffer before admission.

recovery.source: the exact saved four-scientist Q20 state after 10 completed identities
recovery.next: finish the exact 10 unprocessed Q20 identities, then run the frozen Q40-1 bank
recovery.execution: three one-thread Q-grown persistent workers run alongside the immutable v3 worker; the remaining cyclic-memory and four SKM lineages then run as a five-process one-thread wave; at most six experiment CPU cores total

promotion: After every candidate has completed common Q40-1 identities, prune using the final 10 identities: new solves and coverage, capped L10/L1000 improvement, network evaluations and wall time needed to cross the block, retention, high-strand capability, and architecture or lineage diversity.
dkt72: Keep DKT72 out of training and selection until a checkpoint is ready for the registered frozen evaluation; use separate SKM challenge targets for training.
